# PDF.js 6.3.289

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/pdfjs-dist/-/pdfjs-dist-6.3.289.tgz

Vendored from the official `pdfjs-dist` npm release, verified against its SHA-512 integrity metadata.
`build/` contains the minified **legacy** display and worker modules. CMaps, standard fonts and WASM decoders
are served locally, so PDF conversion does not require a CDN or additional Python packages.
Upstream licenses are included beside the corresponding assets. Do not edit generated files.

To upgrade, replace the display module, worker and supporting resources together with one verified release,
retain its licenses, update this version note, and run the PDF browser tests, including Chinese text and scanned pages.
